## Chat05B review fixes

Base: `main@00ce2baca8dca177dfadffcb8bccbae11bca118f`
Current HEAD: `595532694fb2556637b55b27671237b41d52b7a6`
This PR remains Draft and unmerged.

### Finding 1: one authoritative lifecycle state

`gameplay_social_votes` remains the immutable Chat05A trigger/opening record. Its legacy `status='open'` is not the lifecycle authority and is never changed.

`gameplay_social_vote_deadlines` is the sole Chat05B open/closed authority. Closed sidecar state and its terminal tally/choice are immutable. D1 rejects new human and NPC ballots after close. Exact human-ballot replay remains idempotent after close; conflicting choices fail. Repeated result reads return the stored outcome. `gameplay-server/CHAT05B_CONTRACT.md` defines the future Chat05C boundary: it must gate on sidecar `status='closed'`, consume the immutable tally/choice, and must not infer lifecycle state from or mutate the Chat05A row.

### Finding 2: deadline and delayed D1 INSERT

The implemented cutoff is the trusted Worker timestamp bound immediately before D1 dispatch, checked by the authoritative D1 insert trigger against the immutable deadline. It is **not** a claim that D1 transaction commit occurs before the deadline. The regression uses an explicit hold/release barrier: it captures `D-1`, holds native `.run()`, advances the Worker test clock to `D+1`, confirms release time is at/after D, and only then calls native D1. The saved ballot retains `D-1`; subsequent close includes exactly one human plus six NPC fixture ballots and produces a non-tied quorum-7 result. If the close transaction commits first, the held human insert fails closed.

### Validation on exact HEAD

- Independent critical review: `PASS_CRITICAL_REVIEW`, report `CR461-FINAL-20261031-5955326`, reviewer agent `<HOME>/chat05b_pr461_final_review`. It independently verified the remote tree and all five blob SHAs, examined lifecycle/auth/migration/atomicity and the exact delayed-insert contract, ran SQL post-close probes, 12/12 SQLite tests, and a full local Wrangler/workerd/D1 run (session `47543`).
- GitHub Actions: all 8 exact-HEAD check-runs succeeded, including both PR and push executions of `private-api-local`, `sqlite-cas`, `wrangler-local-d1`, and `capture`. [PR workflow](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/41169584018), [push workflow](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/41169580000).
- Local Python SQLite migration/security tests: 12/12 passed. Full local Wrangler/workerd/D1 suite passed, including populated 0011 migration, Chat05A authorization/participant exclusion, quorum matrix 0/1/4/6/7, post-close negatives/replay, close races, rollback/retry, restart and missed-scheduler recovery.

No Cloudflare deployment or remote D1 migration was performed. No changes to migrations 0001-0010, Chat05C, Chat06, economy, REP, or event logs are included.
